scope: Reconstruction of 3299 saved bin uncertainties and weights from archived alpha and membership counts. Static audit of raw-noise source; no new raw-counter replay.
formula: sigma_i = alpha_p / sqrt(n_i); alpha is the one-second fractional-rate coefficient in units 1e-18, equivalently Allan white-frequency-noise coefficient normalized at 1 s.
alpha_algorithm: Eligible original segments have >=8192 retained nominal one-second members. Subtract segment-centred fixed unit tide; overlapping Allan deviation at 256,512,1024,2048,4096 nominal seconds; length-weighted arithmetic average of deviations across eligible segments at each tau; geometric average of deviation*sqrt(tau/1s) across five taus.
